subject: SLA exception request: night capacity and temporary P1/P2 response adjustments
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel@novastack.io>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com
Cc: eng@novastack.io
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 22:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: temporary night window SLA adjustments for migration

Hi Camila,

Quick note — we have a planned infra migration for NovaStack on 2026-12-01 that will run nightly maintenance windows and increased deploy churn between 00:00–06:00 PST for ~10 business days. Our legal and ops team asked whether Redwood can provide a temporary SLA carveout for the night window so that our on-call does not get noisy paging for non-customer-impacting events.

Specifically we are asking for: 
- Temporary P1 response target 45 minutes (standard is 15) for 00:00–06:00 PST for the migration period
- Temporary P2 response target 4 hours for the same window
- Confirmation of escalation path and on-call contacts during the window

Attached is the migration plan and scope (novastack_migration_plan.pdf). We need the mutual action plan and an amendment to the current SLA to sign.

Can Redwood help with the exception and send a proposed amendment? We are targeting minimal impact for production, but we want to ensure clear routing for true P1 incidents.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Director, Platform Reliability
NovaStack, Inc.

Attachments: novastack_migration_plan.pdf

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel@novastack.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 07:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: temporary night window SLA adjustments for migration

Hi Daniel — thanks for the heads up and for the migration plan.

We can support a temporary exception but need to confirm precise paging rules and fallback behavior for true customer-impacting outages. I can run this through our ops exception flow and get a formal amendment drafted. To help us scope it correctly: 
- Can you confirm how you will mark an event as "customer-impacting" during the migration (page vs. monitor-only)?
- Are you asking Redwood to suppress automatic P1 pages for non-customer-impacting alerts, or to extend the target for all P1s?

I've looped in Ben (AM) and Karthik (SRE lead) to propose an internal playbook and on-call escalation chain. Marissa from CS is on copy to align any downstream communications or credits.

We expect to propose: 
- A narrow exception window: 2026-12-01T00:00:00-08:00 through 2026-12-14T06:00:00-08:00 (10 business days)
- P1 response target increased to 45 minutes during window, with an exception to immediate paging for events flagged as non-impacting by NovaStack monitoring
- Mandatory emergency escalation: if an event meets production-impact criteria it retains standard P1 handling (immediate page -> on-call escalation)

I'll follow up with an internal readout and a draft amendment (DocuSign link) by EOD.

—Camila
Camila Reyes
Account Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -08:00
Subject: INTERNAL: NovaStack night-window exception — proposed playbook (please review)

Team — internal draft for discussion before we send the amendment to NovaStack. Quoting Daniel's ask above.

Proposal summary:
- Window: 2026-12-01 00:00 PST -> 2026-12-14 06:00 PST
- P1 target during window: 45 minutes (instead of standard 15). P2: 4 hours (instead of 2).
- Preserved fast-path for production-impacting incidents: any alert marked "production-impact" by NovaStack monitoring triggers standard immediate escalation (page + SMS + phone).
- Page routing: 
  1) Primary on-call (standard roster) — first 45 minutes for triage; if no ack, escalate to
  2) Senior on-call (escalation role) — 20 minutes; if unresolved,
  3) Karthik (SRE lead) — manual escalation to incident bridge and exec notification if impact confirmed.

Operational notes:
- We will not automatically suppress metric-based P1s; instead NovaStack must set labels on alerts to indicate "maintenance-nonimpact". Our webhook will treat labeled alerts as monitor-only and not page, per the exception.
- Require NovaStack to open a joint incident channel (they provided Slack channel #novastack-migration) and to confirm tagging by 2026-11-27.
- Proposed amendment will include a clause for post-mortem within 5 business days if any P1s occurred during the window.

Attachments: temp_sla_exception_playbook.md (internal draft)

Questions / asks:
- Ben: confirm commercial acceptance and whether we should offer a one-time credit for noisy navigation events.
- Karthik: confirm the escalation timings and whether you want runbook owners designated for the window.
- Marissa: I may need your help drafting the customer-facing note and the follow-up comms post-migration.

Please reply with edits inline; I'll consolidate and send the amendment to Daniel.

—Camila

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel@novastack.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary night window SLA adjustments for migration

Hi Daniel — thanks again for the migration plan. Per our internal review, Redwood can grant a limited exception with the following items to be confirmed before we finalize the amendment: 

1) Exception window: 2026-12-01T00:00:00-08:00 through 2026-12-14T06:00:00-08:00 (inclusive).
2) SLA adjustments for that window only: P1 response target changed to 45 minutes; P2 target changed to 4 hours.
3) Paging rules: NovaStack must tag maintenance/non-impact alerts with label "maintenance-nonimpact". Alerts without the label will follow standard SLA routing.
4) Escalation chain for flagged events: Primary on-call -> Senior on-call -> Karthik (SRE lead) -> Exec notification. If an event meets production-impact criteria at any step, standard P1 escalation remains in effect.
5) Operational requirements: joint Slack channel (#novastack-migration) and a post-migration post-mortem to be delivered within 5 business days for any P1s.

I've attached the internal playbook we used to scope this (temp_sla_exception_playbook.md). If this aligns with NovaStack's expectations we will prepare a short amendment and route it for signature (DocuSign link will be provided). We can also include a one-time goodwill credit for noisy deploys if you'd like; Ben can confirm next steps on credits.

Please reply with confirmation of the tagging process and the shared channel, and we'll send the amendment.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: temp_sla_exception_playbook.md
